_: How the vendor agent is invoked. Read once when the daemon starts.
Arguments are grouped so that a group holding a place nobody filled is
dropped whole. A task that named no model has to lose --model with it.
The goal leads the prompt. After the instruction the command is read as
ordinary text and gates nothing, which is why the order is written here
rather than left to whoever composes the two.
--output-format is not here. The code that reads the answer expects one
format, and the two would drift apart if they sat in different places.
The turn and spend limits guard against a run that goes nowhere. They
are filled from the code today and from the session's budget once the
supervisor works out a task's own ceiling.
